phases.name: Setup
phases.note: Thirteen days, and the first day either of you works on this. Two items have waiting periods and both start on day one.

phases.name: Month 1 — Launch
phases.note: Publish, and start talking to people. Thirty days of content, and the outbound rhythm begins.

phases.name: Month 2 — Build
phases.note: Two things usually happen this month: AML supervision lands, and the first clients arrive.

phases.name: Month 3 — Convert
phases.note: The November deadline, then the seasonal run into January. The first real numbers to judge it on.

days.label: Tue 1 Sep
days.one: Start the two clocks. Nothing else in the ninety days matters as much as these two going in today.

tasks.t: Apply for the ICB Practice Licence. £94 application, then £373–£406 a year (£206 licence plus £167–£200 membership). It includes MLR supervision, which is the thing that lets Klyara lawfully take bookkeeping clients. Stated processing time is 28 days, so applying today means supervision lands around 29 September — before launch has had a month to produce anybody. Applying a fortnight later would put it into the middle of the launch. See docs/17 §1 for why this beats registering with HMRC directly (£300 plus £400 per premises, up to 45 days).
Start the Google Business Profile claim. Verification is 5 to 14 days and every local-SEO result in this plan sits behind it.
Write both dates on a wall. Every "when can we take a client" decision keys off the licence date, and it is the question you will be asked most.
Get Professional Indemnity Insurance quotes — it is a condition of the licence, and ICB members get a discounted route.
Sit down together for thirty minutes and read docs/18. It is the list of thirty decisions only the two of you can make, and the sooner they are made the less of this plan is guesswork.

days.label: Wed 2 Sep
days.one: Kill the testimonials. Nothing else on the site matters until they are gone.

tasks.t: Remove the five homepage testimonials. Marcus B., Dean W., Sam O., Priya T., Jodie F. Replace with the honest-new-firm block in docs/07 §Option B. This is not optional and nothing else in this plan matters until it is done.
Read docs/07 top to bottom. It is 15 minutes and it is the only document that describes a legal exposure.
Go through the site and future-tense every claim that is not true today: certifications, '24/7 answering', the AI services, the client portal. docs/07 has the checklist.
Create social@klyara.com. Put it in Bitwarden. Turn on 2FA.
Buy tryklyara.com (~£10). Do not point it anywhere yet.

days.label: Thu 3 Sep
days.one: Finish the Google Business Profile, and get the compliance admin off the list.

tasks.t: Finish the Google Business Profile claim you started yesterday, now that the address decision is made. docs/02 has the full listing copy, written to Google's character limits.
Seed the first four Google Q&A entries from docs/26 PART 4. Ten minutes, and it stops a stranger answering "how much does it cost?" on your behalf.
Chase the PII quotes from yesterday if none have come back.
Read docs/07 top to bottom. Fifteen minutes, and it is the only document that describes a legal exposure.

days.label: Fri 4 Sep
days.one: Analytics and pixels, so you are collecting from day one.

tasks.t: Install GA4 on klyara.com. Set two conversions: book_call and download_guide.
Verify Google Search Console (domain property) and submit the sitemap.
Install the Meta Pixel. Yes, with zero ad budget. The retargeting audience you do not collect this month does not exist next month.
Install the LinkedIn Insight Tag.
Check every calculator page is in the sitemap. docs/08 §10 has the full technical list.

days.label: Sat 5 Sep
days.one: Publish web/tools.html, then the schema. Ten pages already link to the tools page.

tasks.t: Paste the AccountingService block from docs/08 §1 into the site-wide head. Fill in the bracketed address and founding date.
Paste WebSite on the homepage (docs/08 §2).
Paste FAQPage on the MTD page (docs/08 §3) — your 16 questions are currently earning nothing.
Validate each page at search.google.com/test/rich-results. Ten seconds a page, and it catches the typos that silently kill a whole block.
Nothing. You have a 90-day run starting in a week and starting tired is a bad trade.
Upload web/construction-bookkeeping-guildford.html. Paste the page body into your template and delete the inline CSS — it is only there so the file stands alone for review.
Replace [CAL_LINK] with your Cal.com URL and [STREET]/[POSTCODE] in the schema.
Upload two images the schema points at: assets/logo/klyara-mark-disc-512.png and a 1200×630 crop of assets/banners/x-header-1500x500.png as /assets/og/klyara-og.png.
Link to it from the homepage footer and the services page. An orphan page ranks for nothing.
Submit the URL in Search Console.

days.label: Tue 8 Sep
days.one: Brevo, and the DNS that has to propagate before you send anything.

tasks.t: Create the Brevo account. docs/05 §1 explains why Brevo over the alternatives and when to migrate off it.
Add the SPF, DKIM and DMARC records from docs/05 §4. DMARC at p=none to start. Do not go straight to reject.
Create the six lists from docs/05 §2: Newsletter, MTD Guide, Launch Kit, Solo Waitlist, Clients, Partners.
Add the seven contact attributes. Doing this now is ten minutes; retrofitting it onto a mixed list in November is a bad afternoon.
Set the sender: Craig at Klyara <craig@klyara.com>. Never no-reply@.

days.label: Wed 9 Sep
days.one: Load the email sequences while you have quiet.

tasks.t: Build the three-email welcome sequence (docs/05 §5).
Build the five-email MTD guide sequence (docs/05 §6).
Build the four-email Launch Kit sequence (docs/05 §7).
Paste email/template.html in as a custom template and email/signature.html into Gmail.

Start the warm-up. Day 1–3 is 20 sends: yourself, both founders, friends, the partner accountant. The ramp in docs/05 §4 is not optional — a cold domain that suddenly sends 2,000 emails goes to spam and takes months to recover.

days.label: Thu 10 Sep
days.one: Set up the profiles you can do without waiting on anything.

tasks.t: Decide the handle. Order of preference: klyara → klyarahq → klyara_uk → getklyara. Whatever you land on, use it everywhere, even where a better one is free.
LinkedIn Company Page — copy in docs/02 §2, logo assets/avatars/klyara-avatar-linkedin-512.png, cover assets/banners/linkedin-company-1128x191.png.

Rebuild Craig's personal LinkedIn: headline, About, banner, Featured, custom URL, creator mode on. Copy in docs/02 §3. This profile does more work than the company page — LinkedIn gives personal posts several times the reach.
Get a real headshot. On site, in a van, in hi-vis. Not a suit, not a logo, not AI.
Facebook Page (docs/02 §4) + set both founders as admins. Businesses lose pages when the one admin leaves.
Instagram, converted to a Professional account → auto-creates Threads.
X, YouTube (+ the five playlists), TikTok (Business account).
Reddit ×2 — Craig's human account and the brand account. Then stop. Read only for three weeks. docs/01 §Reddit Protocol.
Bluesky (+ verify the domain via DNS TXT — free, ten minutes, real trust signal), Pinterest, Snapchat (claim and leave), Nextdoor.

days.label: Sat 12 Sep
days.one: Directories. Boring, one-off, and they compound.

tasks.t: Lock the NAP string from docs/02 and never vary it by a character.

Trustpilot, Yell, FreeIndex, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect. third for "construction bookkeeper Surrey", above most of the actual firms. Free placement above your competitors is not something to skip because it feels unglamorous.
Then Cylex, Scoot, Thomson Local, Hotfrog, 192.com.
Surrey-specific: Surrey Chambers enquiry, Business Surrey, thebestof Guildford (docs/11 §6).

notes: 2a. directory.getsurrey.co.uk — twenty minutes, and in the August 2026 search it was ranking

days.label: Sun 13 Sep
days.one: Load the week and then stop.

tasks.t: Register on the forums — profiles only, no signature yet: Screwfix Community, UK Business Forums, BookaBuilderUK, ContractorsTalk, UKPlumbersForums, ElectriciansForums.
Request to join 12–15 Facebook groups (docs/01 §Facebook groups has the search strings and the vetting rule). Approval can take days, so ask now.
Schedule tomorrow's launch posts. Manually — you are not buying a scheduler until month two, and posting by hand for a month teaches you what a scheduler hides.
Read docs/09 — the sales pack. Tomorrow the phone might ring.

Read docs/21 and docs/22. Then do three small things that take twenty minutes between them and are very hard to add later: put "founding client rate, held for twelve months" on the pricing page; put the £285 bought-separately comparison on the pricing page and in the proposal template; and diarise the price review for 1 September 2027.
Attach assets/sales/Klyara-Schedule-of-Services.pdf to the engagement letter template so it goes out with client 1, not client 12.

Print assets/print/Klyara-Trade-Counter-Card-A4-4up.pdf — A4 at 100%, no scaling, trim to the crop marks. Fifty sheets is two hundred cards and costs about £15. They go on merchant trade counters in Week 2 (docs/23 §PART 5).
Put the docs/23 §PART 7 outbound blocks into the diary as recurring appointments. Do this now, while it is quiet.

Read docs/26. Then seed the first four Google Business Profile Q&A entries — they are written out and it is ten minutes. The panel being empty on launch day is a wasted asset, and if you leave it, a stranger eventually answers "how much does it cost?" on your behalf.

notes: # THE 90 DAYS
Setup 1-13 September. Launch Monday 14 September. Day 90 is Saturday 12 December.
## The weekly rhythm — it repeats every week, forever
Mon 07:30  Anchor post + GBP post + reply to weekend comments     30 min
Tue        Short video, native upload to each platform            20 min
Wed 17:30  Carousel + the community slot (no links)               45 min
Thu        Long video or the week's big piece                     2h
Fri 16:00  Practical post + production hour + log the numbers     90 min
Sat        One light human post                                   15 min
Sun        Week-ahead deadlines post                              20 min
The Wednesday community slot is the one people cancel. Don't. It is the slot that builds the
pipeline, and it is slow precisely because it works.

days.label: Day 90
days.one: Day 90. Write down what you learned.

tasks.t: Final numbers: booked calls/month, cost per call, clients, list size, reviews, community contributions.
Write a one-page honest note: what worked, what did not, what you would not do again.
Then book the session with me. The list of what I need from you is in docs/18.
The Saturday light post      — nobody notices
The Sunday week-ahead        — merge it into Monday
Instagram and TikTok         — lowest direct return of the set
The long video               — batch two next week instead
The carousel                 — reuse an old one
The community slot           — LAST. It is slow, it compounds, and stopping resets it. Booked discovery calls  ·  Cost per booked call Guide downloads         ·  GBP calls + directions + clicks

notes: # The fallback plan — if a week goes wrong
It will. A big job lands, someone's off sick, the week disappears. Here is what to protect and what
to drop, in order.
Never drop (25 minutes a week):
Monday GBP post          5 min   Posts no longer expire, but only the newest shows prominently. A stale profile reads as "gone bust".
Monday anchor post      15 min   The one post that carries the week.
Reply to comments        5 min   Not replying is worse than not posting.
Drop in this order when you have to:
Never drop the community slot for two weeks running. Reddit and forum credibility decays and the
accounts go quiet in a way that is visible.
# Total time commitment, honestly
| Period | Hours/week | What it covers |
| Phase 0 (pre-launch) | ~16 hours total | One-off setup, most of it never repeated |
| Days 1–30 | 9–11 h/wk | Launch month, heaviest by design |
| Days 31–60 | 7–8 h/wk | Plus client onboarding when it starts |
| Days 61–90 | 6–7 h/wk | The rhythm is established and the library is built |
| Steady state | 2–3 h/wk | Monday anchor, Wednesday community, Friday production |
If it is taking more than three hours a week after day 90, either it is working and you hire, or you
are overproducing for channels that are not returning. Both have obvious answers.
# The printable week
Pin this up. It is the whole system.
│  MON 07:30   Anchor post → LinkedIn, X, FB, IG               │
│              GBP post (expires in 7 days — never skip)       │
│              Reply to everything from the weekend            │
│  TUE         Short video → TikTok, Reels, Shorts             │
│              Native upload to each. Never cross-post.        │
│  WED 17:30   Carousel → Instagram + LinkedIn document        │
│              COMMUNITY SLOT — one real answer, no link       │
│  THU         The week's big piece — long video or page       │
│              Newsletter, on the fortnight                    │
│  FRI 16:00   Practical post (a tool, a template, a date)     │
│              PRODUCTION HOUR — next week written & scheduled │
│              LOG THE FOUR NUMBERS                            │
│  SAT         One light human post. 15 minutes.               │
│  SUN         Week-ahead deadlines post. 20 minutes.          │
